Thank you Gabby for micromanaging everything so that I can breathe a little, and a very special thank you to all of my readers who made all of this possible. If my novel brought you here, I hope that this comic helps bring the written words to life. There were many challenges in personally adapting my own novel into a script, but through doing so, I feel I grew as both a writer and creator. For those of you who are starting out this story for the first time, welcome! I hope you enjoy the little world I created.
